title: RadioDune
description: Make Radio Cool Again. A unified audio platform with 50,000+ live radio stations across 200+ countries, a 100K+ podcast catalog, AI-powered recommendations, real-time ICY/HLS metadata, and full support for 14 languages. Progressive web app built to stream anything, anywhere.

title: OndaCast
description: A radio station and podcast directory built for the web and Smart TV. Designed for the living room and the browser simultaneously — browse, discover, and stream radio and podcasts on any screen.

title: tend.host
description: Managed hosting where AI agents handle the operations layer. The idea: your servers, running themselves — smarter. Built with SvelteKit, Claude API, and a lot of conviction that hosting doesn't have to be a headache.

title: tenddash
description: A unified command center for your digital infrastructure. Bring clarity to the chaos — deployments, uptime, alerts, and analytics in one place. Currently in active development.

title: wilkinsantana.com
description: This very site — a cinematic personal portfolio built with SvelteKit, TailwindCSS, and mdsvex. Dark/light theme, scroll animations, full blog system. Open source.

title: 360° Aerial Portfolio
description: An ongoing visual project — 360° and aerial photography capturing landscapes, moments, and places most people only see from one angle. Because perspective matters.
